snippet.title: Simon the Sorcerer Origins Launch Trailer (English)
snippet.description:
Step into the magical world of Simon the Sorcerer Origins – the official prequel to the legendary point-and-click adventure classic!

Discover the untold story of Simon’s first steps into magic in a brand-new tale filled with humor, puzzles, and enchantment.

Join young Simon as he embarks on his first great adventure between two worlds – the real and the fantastical – meeting familiar faces and uncovering how it all began.

Featuring hand-drawn art, full English and German voice acting with the original actors, and a soundtrack blending nostalgia with new magic.

Available now on PC, Mac, Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, Xbox and Linux.
More information or physical orders at https://www.iningames.com

#SimonTheSorcerer #PointAndClick #Adventure #IndieGame #LaunchTrailer
